title: Data & usage
summary: See your store's usage against its plan, and download everything with Export all data.

blocks.text: Setup › **Data & usage** shows how much your store uses: users, items and file storage, against the limits of its plan. Numbers update every night.

items: Near or over a limit, a note says so. Nothing stops working: KloudC will contact you about the plan.
**Export all data** makes one file with everything your store has: every list as a spreadsheet file, plus your uploaded files. Passwords and keys are never in it.
When it is ready, a **Download link** appears. It works for a limited time; after that, make a new export.
